metadata.description: Portfolio of Marjory Victória Frojoni — journalist, documentary filmmaker, podcast host, and media consultant.

hero.name: Marjory Frojoni
hero.description: Multimedia journalist specializing in social transformation and human-interest storytelling. Experience in high-pressure newsrooms and strategic media relations for major institutions. Focused on the intersection of culture, art, and social advocacy.

about.title: About me
about.bio: Multimedia Journalist and Documentary Filmmaker specializing in social transformation and human-interest storytelling. Currently based in Chicago, IL. Extensive experience in high-pressure newsrooms (TV Globo, UOL) and strategic media relations for major institutions (Sebrae-SP). Focused on the intersection of culture, art, and social advocacy.

educationItems.detail: Thesis (Documentary): Bolshoi in Brazil — Director and producer of a documentary exploring the cultural impact of the Bolshoi Ballet School in Joinville, Brazil.

projectItems.title: Bolshoi in Brazil
projectItems.description: Documentary exploring the only Bolshoi school outside of Russia, focusing on the discipline of dance as a tool for social mobility in Brazil.

projectItems.title: LOBA — Acolhimento
projectItems.description: Social entrepreneurship initiative founded by Marjory, providing support for women and LGBTQIA+ survivors of sexual violence. Consulted for major events on safety protocols and accessibility.
